title: Require the captured text again
description: A backreference matches the same text a capture group already matched.

steps.description: The group captures one or more a characters. After b, the backreference requires that exact captured string.
The inputs include equal and unequal runs of a on either side of b.

steps.question: Will aabaaa pass fullmatch?
steps.answer: No. The captured aa differs from the final aaa.

steps.description: The output accepts the three equal-run inputs and rejects the other two. The backreference enforces repetition of captured text.
